\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 263-266 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R271-first-pass-words-from-chapters-263-266}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for pink and purple.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a vaccine, sweat, a wrist, a thumb, a muscle
  \item a season, childhood, an evening out, Ramadan, the afternoon; an era
  \item a theatre, a cinema, a club, a farm, the countryside
  \item a basement, a chimney, a doorstep, a fence, a courtyard
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A vaccine? (\textbf{\ar{لقاح}}, \emph{laqāḥ}.) Sweat? (\textbf{\ar{عرق}}, \emph{ʿaraq}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\ar{معصم}}, \emph{miʿṣam}.) A thumb? (\textbf{\ar{إبهام}}, \emph{ibhām}.) A muscle? (\textbf{\ar{عضلة}}, \emph{ʿaḍala}.) A season? (\textbf{\ar{فصل}}, \emph{faṣl}.) Childhood? (\textbf{\ar{طفولة}}, \emph{ṭufūla}.) An evening out? (\textbf{\ar{سهرة}}, \emph{sahra}.) Ramadan? (\textbf{\ar{رمضان}}, \emph{ramaḍān}.) The afternoon; an era? (\textbf{\ar{عصر}}, \emph{ʿaṣr}.) A theatre? (\textbf{\ar{مسرح}}, \emph{masraḥ}.) A cinema? (\textbf{\ar{سينما}}, \emph{sīnimā}.) A club? (\textbf{\ar{نادي}}, \emph{nādī}.) A farm? (\textbf{\ar{مزرعة}}, \emph{mazraʿa}.) The countryside? (\textbf{\ar{ريف}}, \emph{rīf}.) A basement? (\textbf{\ar{قبو}}, \emph{qabw}.) A chimney? (\textbf{\ar{مدخنة}}, \emph{midkhana}.) A doorstep? (\textbf{\ar{عتبة}}, \emph{ʿataba}.) A fence? (\textbf{\ar{سياج}}, \emph{siyāj}.) A courtyard? (\textbf{\ar{فناء}}, \emph{fināʾ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 267-271 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R271-second-pass-words-from-chapters-267-271}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tradition and culture.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a tradition, culture, religion, prayer, a relationship
  \item together, according to, without, for example, first
  \item failure, a step, harm, a fault, an advantage
  \item boring, booked, available, international, local
  \item stubborn, lonely; only, orange, pink, purple
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A tradition? (\textbf{\ar{تقليد}}, \emph{taqlīd}.) Culture? (\textbf{\ar{ثقافة}}, \emph{thaqāfa}.) Religion? (\textbf{\ar{دين}}, \emph{dīn}.) Prayer? (\textbf{\ar{صلاة}}, \emph{ṣalāh}.) A relationship? (\textbf{\ar{علاقة}}, \emph{ʿalāqa}.) Together? (\textbf{\ar{معا}}, \emph{maʿan}.) According to? (\textbf{\ar{حسب}}, \emph{ḥasaba}.) Without? (\textbf{\ar{بدون}}, \emph{bidūn}.) For example? (\textbf{\ar{مثلا}}, \emph{mathalan}.) First? (\textbf{\ar{أولا}}, \emph{awwalan}.) Failure? (\textbf{\ar{فشل}}, \emph{fashal}.) A step? (\textbf{\ar{خطوة}}, \emph{khuṭwa}.) Harm? (\textbf{\ar{ضرر}}, \emph{ḍarar}.) A fault? (\textbf{\ar{عيب}}, \emph{ʿayb}.) An advantage? (\textbf{\ar{ميزة}}, \emph{mīza}.) Boring? (\textbf{\ar{ممل}}, \emph{mumill}.) Booked? (\textbf{\ar{محجوز}}, \emph{maḥjūz}.) Available? (\textbf{\ar{متاح}}, \emph{mutāḥ}.) International? (\textbf{\ar{دولي}}, \emph{duwalī}.) Local? (\textbf{\ar{محلي}}, \emph{maḥallī}.) Stubborn? (\textbf{\ar{عنيد}}, \emph{ʿanīd}.) Lonely; only? (\textbf{\ar{وحيد}}, \emph{waḥīd}.) Orange? (\textbf{\ar{برتقالي}}, \emph{burtuqālī}.) Pink? (\textbf{\ar{وردي}}, \emph{wardī}.) Purple? (\textbf{\ar{بنفسجي}}, \emph{banafsajī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
